text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Those three years flew by in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: *yawn*... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Phew... ...That feels so good.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(To be able to train my legs this early in 
the morning...)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
(...To the me of two years ago, this would 
have been unbelievable.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap, tap, tap, tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian-chan! Morning training for you too?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Laurel. Well, that's about the gist of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hey— ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Laurel. You said you looked up to me, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, you have your own place you're 
striving to reach through racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What if I had walked away from running 
back then... ...what would you have done?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —! That—is......

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've never really thought about it 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...I was so desperate, I didn't even have 
time to think."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So that I can become someone who runs 
ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Still, in the end, you didn't let go of 
it! And that brings us to where you are 
right now, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Brian-chan. I really look up to 
you as an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, I know that you are the 
"strongest" that everyone longed for. But—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I won't let it become a curse. Not for 
you, not for everyone. —And not for me, 
either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Before that happens, I'm going to rewrite 
what it means to be the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hey, which race are you running next, 
Brian-chan? Can we race together again?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? If "Her Mightiness" is looking 
for a race, we're bound to clash anyway.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ehh?! You could've told me~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Aah, left behind again. Her getaway speed 
is getting faster and faster, huh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...No way I'm losing next time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Did you go for a morning run?
Did you go for a morning run?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Yes♪ So that I can truly savor the 
'now'.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"This way, I can run in the morning, train 
at noon, and compete in races on the 
weekend."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...It makes me very happy.
choice_data_list:
...Your legs have gotten really sturdy, 
haven't they?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So please leave it to me, whether 
it's training or races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
With these legs, no matter who the 
opponent is, no matter where the goal 
lies— I know I can go beyond it.
